description:
Commits the validation record showing each benchmark arm reproducing its prepared per-frame quality record.

## Background

The gf2 arms of the LDPC batch decoder and the AFF3CT arms [Cassagne2019] are built or catalogued under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms/` and `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms.json`. Their build identity is recorded under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/`. The workloads are the recorded DVB-T2 normal rate-1/2 and 5G NR base-graph-1 lifting-384 mother-code bundles of `dev/active/c077a88b`, pinned by digest, with random and all-zero codewords and a prepared per-frame quality record. The sum-product INTRA arm has its prepared record under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/quality-intra/`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/validation.jsonl` shows each arm, in the validation role and untimed, reproducing its prepared per-frame quality record on each worker.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each validation run passes every placement check, and the record carries the placement reports.
- [hard] REQ-03: The record names each arm by the digest of the build identity record.

## Notes

Source references: [Cassagne2019].
title: Validate the benchmark arms against their quality records
